facts.fact: Kenya's Office of the Data Protection Commissioner is acting: it confirmed on 31 March 2026 an investigation into Meta and two Sama companies, per TechCabal.
facts.system: Office of the Data Protection Commissioner

facts.fact: TechCabal says the ODPC imposed the full KES 5 million (about $38,000) penalty in its first penalty notice, against smartphone maker OPPO in 2022.
facts.system: Office of the Data Protection Commissioner
